prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production UI asset. From the provided fourth card design, create ONE reusable BLANK card FRAME PNG. No three-card sheet. Exactly one vertical 5:7 playing card, straight frontal view, fills entire canvas edge to edge (no exterior margins). High resolution about 1000x1400. Match the dark plum enamel, thin antique gold chamfered border, geometric gold corners, restrained star engravings, ivory title plate and parchment rules panel of reference RIGHT card.
ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENTS: No letters, no text, no numbers, no elemental icons, no illustration or scenery. Real transparent exterior corners. The central illustration window must be genuinely TRANSPARENT so real card art can be drawn behind it, not black, not checkerboard painted into the image.
Layout in percentages of whole card: outer gold chamfered border within 1%-3%; blank ivory title plate x25%-97%, y2%-13%; dark plum vertical cost rail x3%-24%, y3%-53%, ending in a diagonal lower tip. Cost rail is opaque, empty except TWO small faint gold star engravings toward its lower end, no circles or slots. Large transparent illustration window x3%-97%, y14%-63%, except opaque cost rail overlapping its upper-left part. Blank dark plum category ribbon x3%-97%, y64%-71%, with thin gold rules and elegant ends. Blank ivory parchment description panel x3%-97%, y72%-97% with thin gold corners and subtle paper grain. Title and description area very calm for runtime Chinese text. Keep dark purple and gold outline framing transparent art window. Full card only, all elements perfectly aligned, no shadows outside canvas, no text of any kind. Card frame suitable for scaling as a single UI texture. Preserve reference aesthetic closely.
